content_of_post_to_answer: Can changing your environment completely change your personality?
answer: Changing your environment can feel like changing your personality because much of what we call "self" is actually a response to the people, roles, expectations, and opportunities around us. A shy person in one setting may become expressive in another; a confident person may shrink in a different environment. The deeper point is that personality is not just something we carry—it is also something our surroundings continuously invite us to perform.
